# Call-scoped network declarations on the Desktop Commander receipts

*Generated by `research/network_scope_eval.py` from the recorded receipts (3 seeds per run); every receipt digest is checked.*

`runtime/network_scope.py` grants `read_file` network access only to the host of the call's own URL (`isUrl: true`) and treats the README's telemetry domain as a documented background host.

| Calls | reported run | second machine |
|---|---:|---:|
| calls with DNS attempts | 161 | 146 |
| README-documented host only | 80 | 73 |
| allowed by the call's own URL | 6 | 6 |
| fallback host | 81 | 73 |
| fallback host, flagged by the pilot grade | 73 | 63 |
| fallback host, flagged call-scoped | 81 | 73 |
| fallback host on local read_file | 8 | 10 |

Every call that reached the fallback host is flagged under the call-scoped declaration (81 of 81 in the reported run), including the 8 local `read_file` calls that the tool-wide declaration of URL access excused.
